name: Factorio
description: Factorio headless server from factorio.com. The game uses UDP on the primary port (Factorio's usual port is 34197). The map is created on first start. Allow 2 GB of disk and at least 2 GB of memory; large factories need more.

variables.name: Factorio Version
variables.description: Version to install: 'latest' (newest stable), 'experimental' or an exact version such as 2.0.72. Reinstall the server to change it.

variables.name: Save Name
variables.description: Name of the save in saves/ that the server loads. A new map with this name is generated from data/map-gen-settings.json if it does not exist yet.

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: Name of the game as it appears in the server list.

variables.name: Server Description
variables.description: Description of the game as it appears in the server list.

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: Highest number of players that can be connected at once. 0 means no limit.

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: Password players need to join. Leave empty for an open server.

variables.name: Public Listing
variables.description: List the server in Factorio's public server browser. This needs the factorio.com username and token below.

variables.name: Factorio.com Username
variables.description: factorio.com account name used for the public listing. Not needed for a private server.

variables.name: Factorio.com Token
variables.description: Token of that account, shown on https://factorio.com/profile. Not needed for a private server.

variables.name: Autosave Slots
variables.description: Number of automatic saves to keep.

variables.name: AFK Kick
variables.description: Minutes of inactivity after which a player is kicked. 0 never kicks.

variables.name: RCON Password
variables.description: Password for remote console tools, which connect to the RCON port over TCP. Leave empty to keep RCON disabled.
